description: Create scroll-stopping SOCIAL ADS and SHORT-FORM VIDEOS (Reels, TikTok, Shorts, LinkedIn, X, story ads, bumpers) as one self-contained HTML file, vertical 1080×1920 by default (or 1:1, 4:5, 16:9). They open with a hook in the first second, use word slams on the beat, colour flips, phone mockups, burned-in karaoke captions for muted autoplay, a punchy synthesized track and a loopable end frame. Verified frame by frame and exportable to MP4. Use for ads, promos, product teasers, app-store and social clips, "make a reel/TikTok", 6 s bumpers and 15 or 30 s spots, for any brand, product, app, offer or event, in any style. Accepts creative dials --creativity, --typography, --animation and --motion (low, medium or high; medium by default).
